facts.text: Geisinger's Fresh Food Farmacy page presents the program as using food as medicine for diet-responsive conditions such as Type 2 diabetes, giving patients and their households enough food for 10 meals a week.

evidence.title: Fresh Food Farmacy | Geisinger
evidence.quote: Using food as medicine to manage — and prevent — diet-responsive conditions

facts.text: The MyCode Community Health Initiative, Geisinger's DNA sequencing research program, says on its sign-up page that more than 370,000 people have signed up (the page gives no date for the figure).

facts.text: Hernando Ruiz-Jimenez became Geisinger's chief marketing and communications officer in January 2025 and told Becker's that digital experience is "table stakes" and that marketing owns the member and patient portals.

evidence.title: Digital experience is 'table stakes' for Geisinger's new marketing chief
evidence.quote: We have ownership, in marketing, of member and patient portals.

facts.text: In November 2025 Geisinger announced it was a CHIME Most Wired recipient for the sixth consecutive year, with level 10 certification in the ambulatory survey and level 9 in acute care.

evidence.title: Geisinger recognized for digital health achievement as 2025 Most Wired Survey Recipient for sixth consecutive year

strengths.text: Named programs with their own public pages, one of them carrying a participant figure, give the brand concrete stories that a reader can check.
Owned content reaches people in several formats: a searchable article library, a monthly e-newsletter and a quarterly magazine available in print.
Marketing owns the patient and member portals, which lets the portal experience and the marketing message be managed together.
Repeated outside recognition for digital health gives the marketing team a third-party proof point for digital claims.

gaps.text: As of 2026-11-10 the Podcasts page showed a single series, focused on medical student experiences, and the #LifeAtGeisinger listing showed no episode after 11/16/2021.

opportunitiesForUpmc.text: Check which UPMC community programs have a dedicated public page with a current participation figure, the way Fresh Food Farmacy and MyCode do.
A patient-facing podcast is open ground in this comparison, since the series Geisinger lists is aimed at medical students.
Compare how UPMC positions its own portal in marketing against a peer whose marketing chief treats portal adoption as a marketing responsibility.
Geisinger keeps its own name inside Risant Health, so competitive tracking in Pennsylvania should watch Geisinger-branded and Risant-related messaging together.
